passages.heading: Debt note
passages.text: Note 8 – Debt Term Loan In June 2022, the Company entered into a credit agreement with a consortium of lenders for a total $ 195.0 million revolving credit facility (the “Prior Credit Facility”) consisting of a $ 175.0 million term loan and $ 20.0 million in committed delayed-draw term loans with a maturity date of June 10, 2027.

passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and related notes appearing elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Some of the information contained in this discussion and analysis, including information with respect to our planned investments in our research and development, sales and marketing, and general and administrative functions, includes forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties as described under the heading “Special Note About Forward-Looking Statements” in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. You should review the disclosure under the heading “Risk Factors” in this Annual Report on Form 10-K for a discussion of important factors that could cause our actual results to differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements. Unless the context otherwise requires, all references in this Annual Report on Form 10-K to “we,” “us,” “our,” “our company,” and “Rubrik” refer to Rubrik, Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries. Unless otherwise indicated, references to our “common stock” include our Class A common stock and Class B common stock. A discussion regarding our financial condition and results of operations for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026 compared to the fiscal year ended January 31, 2025 is presented below. A discussion regarding our financial condition and results of operations for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2025 compared to the fiscal year ended January 31, 2024 can be found in “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” in the Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2025 filed with the SEC on March 20, 2025. Overview We are on a mission to secure and accelerate the world’s AI transformation. Cyberattacks are inevitable. Prevention and detection are not enough. Realizing that cyberattacks ultimately target data, we created Zero Trust Data Security to deliver cyber resilience so that organizations can secure their data across the cloud and recover from cyberattacks. As enterprises embrace the forthcoming AI transformation, they are grappling with a threat landscape that is now amplified at an AI-scale. We believe that cyber resilience will result in AI resilience and that the future of cybersecurity is data security—if your data is secure, your business is resilient. We built the Rubrik Security Cloud ( “ RSC ” ) suite with Zero Trust design principles to secure data across enterprise, cloud, SaaS, unstructured data, and identity providers. RSC delivers a cloud native SaaS platform that detects, analyzes, and remediates data security risks and unauthorized user activities. Our platform is architected to help organizations achieve cyber resilience, which encompasses cyber posture and cyber recovery. We enable organizations to confidently accelerate digital transformation and leverage the cloud to realize business agility. We launched our first enterprise software product, Converged Data Management, in fiscal 2016, which combined data and metadata together into a single layer of software

passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: Investing in our Class A common stock involves various risks, including those described below. You should consider and read carefully all of the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including the section titled “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” and our consolidated financial statements and related notes, before making an investment decision. The risks described below are not the only ones we face. The occurrence of any of the following risks or additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently believe to be immaterial could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, or results of operations. In such case, the trading price of our Class A common stock could decline, and you may lose some or all of your original investment. Risks Related to Our Business Our recent rapid growth may not be indicative of our future growth. Our rapid growth also makes it difficult to evaluate our future prospects. Our revenue was $1.32 billion, $886.5 million and $627.9 million for the fiscal years ended January 31, 2026, 2025 and 2024, respectively. You should not rely on the revenue growth of any prior period as an indication of our future performance. Even if our revenue continues to increase, we expect that our revenue growth rate will fluctuate in the future as a result of a variety of factors. While we have largely completed both the sales of Rubrik-branded Appliances transitioning from us to our contract manufacturers in fiscal 2025 and the transition for new and existing customers to sales of RSC in fiscal 2026, we expect our subscription revenue to continue to benefit from customers exercising or forfeiting their Subscription Credits (which are customer options that are accounted for as material rights) through fiscal 2027, although we expect the benefits to significantly reduce sequentially. These business transitions cause fluctuations to our total revenue growth and limit the comparability of our revenue with past performance. Overall growth of our revenue also depends on a number of factors, including our ability to: • expand the features and functionality of our data security products as well as increase the amount of data sources protected across enterprise, cloud, SaaS, unstructured data, and identity providers; • securely deploy generative AI while delivering exceptional accuracy and efficiency using agentic applications; • extend our product leadership to expand our addressable market; • differentiate our data security products from products offered by others; • successfully develop a substantial sales pipeline for our products; • hire sufficient sales personnel to support our growth and reduce the time for such personnel to achieve desired productivity levels; • attract new customers and expand sales to our existing customers, including by effectively marketing and pricing our data security products and successfully transitioning existing customers to RSC; • increase awareness of our brand on a global basis as a data security company to successfu

credit_strengths.text: Rubrik's revenue grew strongly year over year, reflecting adoption of its cloud data security platform, while operating losses narrowed materially as the business scaled. This trajectory suggests improving unit economics and supports the view that cash generation can continue to build, although the growth rate may moderate as prior-period transitions annualize.

Operating cash flow turned solidly positive and comfortably funded capital expenditures, leaving meaningful free cash flow. That cash generation, combined with a liquid current-asset position, gives the issuer a credible internal funding source for debt service and investment, reducing reliance on external financing.

key_risks.text: The debt stack is entirely convertible notes, and the prior credit facility matures in the near term, so refinancing and conversion dynamics are central to the credit. A partial debt sum is not total debt, and the absence of a tagged aggregate debt line means the true facility picture may be broader than reported.

Disclosed risk factors highlight that rapid historical growth may not be indicative of future growth, with revenue comparability distorted by appliance and subscription transitions. If growth decelerates or customer transitions stall, the improving operating trend could reverse, pressuring the issuer's ability to service obligations from internally generated cash.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is deeply negative on a reported basis because operating income remains in deficit, even though interest expense is modest relative to the debt balance. Cash flow, not accounting earnings, is currently the relevant servicing metric, and free cash flow covers only a fraction of debt outstanding.

Liquidity is adequate for now: the current ratio sits modestly below the sector median, and cash plus short-term investments exceed debt on a net basis. However, the debt maturity profile is not disclosed in the bundle, which is material because the prior facility matures within the forecast horizon and refinancing risk cannot be fully assessed.

overall_credit_view.text: Rubrik is a growing, cash-generating software issuer with net cash on a broad definition, but reported leverage ratios are not meaningful given negative EBITDA. The indicative financial risk profile is not a rating; it reflects a business still investing heavily and reliant on continued revenue expansion to justify its capital structure.

Our forward view is that credit quality hinges on sustaining free cash flow growth and managing the convertible notes and prior facility maturity. Shareholder returns are not disclosed, so cash uses appear focused on modest acquisitions and internal investment. We would monitor refinancing terms and any acceleration in cash burn as key swing factors.

credit_strengths.text: Rubrik 的收入按年強勁增長，反映其雲端數據安全平台獲廣泛採用，而隨著業務規模擴大，營運虧損大幅收窄。此走勢顯示單位經濟效益改善，並支持現金產生能力可持續增長的觀點，儘管隨著前期過渡期按年化基準計算，增長率可能放緩。
營運現金流轉為穩健正數，並足以輕鬆支付資本開支，留下可觀的自由現金流。該現金產生能力，加上流動的流動資產狀況，為發行人提供了可靠的內部資金來源以償付債務及進行投資，減少對外部融資的依賴。

key_risks.text: 債務結構全為可換股票據，而先前的信貸融資將於短期內到期，因此再融資及轉換動態對信貸至關重要。部分債務總額並非總債務，且缺乏標籤化的總債務項目意味著真實的融資狀況可能比所報告的更為廣泛。
披露的風險因素強調，過往的快速增長未必預示未來增長，收入可比性因設備及訂閱過渡而受到扭曲。若增長放緩或客戶過渡停滯，改善中的營運趨勢可能逆轉，對發行人以內部產生現金償付義務的能力構成壓力。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 按報告基準計算，利息覆蓋率為深度負數，因為營運收入仍處於虧損狀態，儘管利息支出相對於債務餘額而言較為溫和。目前相關的償債指標是現金流而非會計盈利，而自由現金流僅覆蓋未償還債務的一小部分。
目前流動性充足：流動比率略低於行業中位數，而現金加短期投資按淨額基準計算超過債務。然而，債務到期狀況並未在資料集中披露，此點至關重要，因為先前的融資將於預測期內到期，再融資風險無法全面評估。

overall_credit_view.text: Rubrik 是一家持續增長、產生現金的軟件發行人，按廣義定義計算持有淨現金，但由於 EBITDA 為負數，所報告的槓桿比率並不具意義。指示性財務風險狀況並非評級；它反映的是一家仍在大舉投資、並依賴持續收入擴張以支持其資本結構的企業。
我們的前瞻觀點是，信貸質素取決於能否維持自由現金流增長，以及管理可換股票據及先前融資的到期。股東回報並未披露，因此現金用途似乎集中於適度的收購及內部投資。我們將密切關注再融資條款及現金消耗的任何加速，作為關鍵的擺動因素。
